description: Fixtures for the values.md standard, version 0.1. Each entry names a path under this directory, the scope it is checked at, and the outcome a conforming checker must give: valid, invalid or unsupported-version. An invalid entry lists the rules that fail. Its details say why, in the reference checker's own codes: a short word for V1, V2, V4, V5 and V6, and for V3 the path of the schema constraint that rejects the file. A valid entry gives the number of characters in the body and in the core.

fixtures.note: Only the three required fields and a short body. With no core section and a body of 1,500 characters or fewer, the whole body is the core. A steward whose claim is individual needs no url.
Every field the standard defines, with a custom core section name.

A body over 1,500 characters with a ## Core section. The core is the text after the heading line.
A short body that has a core section. The section is the core, not the whole body.
persistence.reinject.section names the core section. The heading matches without regard to the case of A to Z, and a ## Core section is then an ordinary section.
